title: Emergency Fund Calculator for Canadians, With EI Built In
infoGain: A calculator that nets EI (55% to $729/week, 14-week minimum, waiting period waived to Oct 9, 2027) and a four-week bridge floor out of the fund, with targets for three example households at 3 and 6 months.
